subject: Music Production
title: Sampling Rate and Bit Depth
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Sampling Rate and Bit Depth.

hook.text: Digital audio captures sound by measuring the wave's position thousands of times per second.

buildup.text: CD-quality audio samples at 44,100 times per second, called a sampling rate of 44.1 kilohertz.

discovery.text: Bit depth determines how precisely each sample is measured, with sixteen bits offering 65,536 levels.

twist.text: Higher sampling rates and bit depths capture more detail but create much larger audio files.

climax.text: Producers choose sample rates and bit depths that balance quality with storage and processing power.

punchline.text: More samples per second means more sonic detail.

quiz.question: What is the CD-quality sampling rate?
